summary.all_three_derived_export_warnings: Accepted unchanged: exported status, full drawing, still-unsaved changes, full-image copy, and before-replacement sequence all retained.
summary.ordinary_wording_gate: No native-speaker gate imposed. Medium-confidence context/length caveats are retained as caveats, not converted into unsupported linguistic holds.

method: Read every draft entry independently against the exact English values and the three current locale catalogues for UI terminology context; nearby entries are not automatically certified by this review.

Read AGENTS.md, TRANSLATING.md and translations/STRING_IMPORTANCE.md; inspected only the relevant existing ColourStatusButton, PaintCanvas and SaveOptionsDialog code for foreground/background, gesture and export semantics.

Review covers semantic fidelity, concise/natural UI usage, full warning clauses, Save As formats/ellipses, FG/BG distinction, fit-view rather than image resizing, Main-tab sense, two-finger zoom and view-pan sense, placeholder binding and Android-ready XML quoting.
No external-source hunt, remote action, production/index edit or Android workflow run was used.

validation.android_escaping_scope: All values use balanced Android double-quote delimiters. XML characters are escaped. No internal literal double quote, backslash, control character, or leading resource-reference marker needs additional escaping. This is lexical inspection, not aapt compilation.
validation.exact_catalogue_gaps: All 11 keys absent per locale in the read-only source snapshot; 5 P0 + 6 P1 each.

limits: This independent linguistic judgment covers only these 33 exact final values; it does not revive withdrawn historical acceptance, review surrounding strings, or certify entire catalogues.
Reported PR equivalence was not independently checked remotely during this original review; exact reviewed English values were compared locally.
No Android compilation, device/layout/font-size/orientation, TalkBack, CI or whole-repository validation was performed.
Haitian Creole Premye plan and the descriptive gesture labels have unresolved visual-fit/readability verification, not demonstrated wording defects.
Main and other legacy strings were reviewed using the supplied source role; no live use of an unreferenced legacy resource is asserted.

rows.independent_backtranslation: Mode for bringing two fingers together or moving them apart and moving the view
rows.rationale: The descriptive nominal phrase names bringing two fingers together OR moving them apart, then moving the view. Thus pinch-in/pinch-out zoom and panning are both retained; it is not a literal pinch of image content. Its length is a presentation caveat, but shortening it to view movement alone would lose the zoom gesture.
nonblocking_caveats: Descriptive label is longer than English; no device or layout fit has been established. The exact legacy key is not being claimed as a current live control.
